lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a matrix posterior to the gill slits. The largest and most defined centroids are located along the mid-lateral line, forming a series of approximately 10-12 visible vertical columns across the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs. These intersections create a grid-like pattern where the high-luminance blobs serve as nodes at the junction of the vertical stripes and the lateral horizontal alignment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two prominent longitudinal ridges (carinae) are visible running horizontally across the upper flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and a well-defined shadow gradient immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin's silhouette contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs. These spots are smaller and less regularly spaced than those on the main flank, with a higher concentration observed near the leading edge and base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct, elongated high-luminance feature is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region, likely a commensal organism, which creates a sharp contrast against the darker lower flank.
